name: iran-tcp443
description: NO-UDP mix for networks where UDP is throttled, blocked or rate-limited, and where a QUIC-shaped flow is itself the signal. Drops every udp_gated family. NOT a 443-only mix, despite the profile name: only vless-reality lands on 443. naive is on 8444, websocket-tls on 8445, and the two opt-in families on 8446 (shadowsocks) and 8447 (anytls). On a strict 53/80/443 whitelist — Iran's stated posture — everything but vless-reality is dropped before any classifier runs.
